name: How can I make my pool more modern and luxurious during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: How can I make my pool more modern and luxurious during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: To achieve a modern and luxurious pool, consider incorporating contemporary design elements and high-end features. This can include sleek, minimalist coping and decking materials, such as large format porcelain tiles or honed natural stone. Integrating perimeter overflow or zero-edge designs creates a sophisticated aesthetic. Advanced LED lighting, elegant water features like sheer descents or scuppers, and automation systems for effortless control contribute to a luxury experience. A custom spa addition and integrated landscaping also elevate the overall ambiance.
acceptedAnswer.description: To modernize your pool, incorporate sleek materials, zero-edge designs, advanced LED lighting, elegant water features, and automation systems. Custom spas and integrated landscaping also enhance luxury.
